name: menu_icon_kaihatsu
screen: Minigame menu icon "under construction" (traffic cone; not seen on any menu page)
compression: none (raw NGPC 2bpp tiles, 16 bytes per 8x8 tile)

map.entry: ROM word = tile index | palette<<9 | Vflip<<14 | Hflip<<15 (tile index counts from the start of the tile block)
map.loader: object command at 0xD2FC8: [op16][map16][01 00][tile ptr 24][00][count16]; the tile block of command k uses the map field of command k+1 (map = 0xD0000 + map16)

cells_format: [tile, palette, hflip, vflip] row by row

png_index_map.note: transparent (colour 0 of every palette); shown as the screen backdrop colour

palette.assumed: never shown in MAME; palette = the map's palette number, colours from the unlocked menu screen

max_size.note: Stay inside the 32x32 px area. The tile block holds 13 tiles; tiles listed in shared_with_rest_of_screen are also used outside this area and must not change (or the map must be repointed to free tiles).
